column3: Settled in the pack - urged forward to move through field over 2f out - edged in front approaching final furlong - wandered left in the run-in but kept finding more to win
Settled towards the back - driven on and moved left to make progress over 2f out - closed on the front pair and urged forward inside the final furlong - stayed on well but narrowly denied
Settled at back early - urged into action approaching 2f out - finished strongly late and hard driven inside final furlong - grabbed third close home
Handy up with the pace early - driven on approaching 2f out and staying on with a shout entering the final furlong - squeezed for space late and unable to add more finishing 4th beaten 2 lengths
Sent clear early but under pressure throughout - driven and lost front spot 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 5th beaten 5.5 lengths
Sat handy behind the front group - asked for effort over 2f out and faded from there - well held at the finish in 6th
Sat close to front - hit the front two out under driving before giving way inside final furlong - faded quickly to finish seventh
Settled in the pack - urged forward and made progress inside final two furlongs - faded quickly nearing the last furlong - finished eighth
Sat close to front group early - urged forward before fading 2f out - well held at the finish

Right side deviation early - travelled close to the front - shared command before the 5th - went clear in front by the 7th - challenged again 3 out - driven out and a length to the good 2 out - held the edge approaching the last - stayed on to win

Settled in rear of pack early - edged into second spot 4 out before needing urging - stayed close to front runners 2 out - stayed on well approaching final furlong - claimed second close home - came home unable to close further

Settled in the pack early - made progress 4 out and driven into contention to challenge 3 out - a length off the pace 2 out - stayed on to the last - unable to find more and edged out for second close home

Sat close up early - fumbled at the 3rd - made progress by the 12th - pushed along before the 14th - still handy with the front group 4 out - asked for effort soon after and dropped away then unable to close from 2 out - finished well held in 4th
Erratic pace early - settled towards back - nudged into contention approaching 3 out but clipped it - lost ground late and stumbled at the last

Set the pace early - had company approaching the 5th and drifted off a true line before losing top spot at the 7th - dropped away and needed urging before 4 out - eased out of contention approaching 2 out
settled just behind the pace - hit the front over 1f out - asked for effort and pulled away - kept finding more to score with ease
Sat close behind pace in second - dropped back when asked for effort over 2f out - found renewed energy inside final furlong but unable to close on winner
Tracked front group wide - pressed for effort over 2f out and briefly found lacking - finished with renewed effort in the final furlong but never got competitive - third beaten 2.75 lengths
settled midpack early - made smooth progress from 3f out - pressed for effort 2f out - stayed on late without reaching contention for the win
Held handy midpack early - urged forward approaching final 3f then battled into contention for third inside final furlong - weakened close home to finish 5th
Set the pace early - driven with two furlongs left before losing top spot approaching the final furlong - dropped away steadily to finish sixth
Slow to start - held up towards back - hampered 3f out - driven approaching final furlong - kept on late without threatening leaders - finished seventh
Sat close to the pace - moved left and driven approaching 2f out - dropped away in the final furlong - finished eighth
slow to break - held towards back - nudged into contention over 2f out then asked for effort with nothing to give - finished 9th well held
Held up towards the back - urged forward with 3f left - unable to land a blow - finished well beaten in 10th
Held up in the back markers - driven for effort with 3f left - unable to find any headway - well held in 11th
Settled midpack early - nudged for effort 3f out and hampered soon after - lost touch under pressure 2f out - well held at the finish
Held up in midfield - driven and dropped away 3f out - soon under pressure and well held
Settled midfield early - urged forward approaching 3f out - dropped away with 2f left to run - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - never involved - well beaten at the finish
Settled at the back early - moved through the field after the 6th - closed on the pace approaching 2 out - stood off well to take command at the last and stayed on for the win

Set the pace early - stumbled at the 6th - came under pressure and asked for effort before 2 out - blundered and gave up front spot at the last - dropped the stick soon after - stayed on but unable to reach winner

Settled with strong grip early - up in touch and moved into second spot for a spell - untidy at the 4th - errored again at the 6th - pushed along and lost touch with the front pair 2 out - continued on at an even effort to finish third

Pulled hard in the early stages - not consistently smooth at the obstacles - dropped back momentarily at the 2nd - fell further behind after the 6th - beaten for pace and under pressure before 2 out - no threat from the last and finished well held in 4th
Fought for control early - held up at the rear throughout - never a factor - finished well held in 5th
Settled midfield - moving easily through the pack - advanced 2f out to hit the front approaching the final furlong - driven out and kept finding more to the line

Settled towards back of pack early - made progress from 3f out - driven with vigour approaching 2f out - moved into third and urged clear - kept up finishing effort but couldn't reel in winner finishing second
Settled in the pack - advanced into contention 3f out - hit the front over 2f out under pressure - lost the advantage inside the final furlong and stayed on same effort to finish third
Held up towards back of pack - progress from 3f out - pushed along with 2f left - up into fourth inside final furlong - kept on same speed to finish 4th
Settled at the back - urged into contention with over 2f left and made gradual late progress - unable to challenge the front rank - finished fifth beaten 5 lengths
Sat close to pace early - driven into advantage 3f out - lost front spot after 2f out under pressure - eased back through the closing stages
Held up in the pack - driven approaching the final furlong - couldn't find any extra - faded to finish seventh
Held up towards the back - failed to feature - finished well beaten in 8th
Sent to front early - driven when overtaken 3f out - faded to finish well beaten
Sat close to the pace early - urged to keep up before dropping away over 2f from home - trailed to the line
Handy behind front group early - driven 3f out and lost touch - well held at finish
Held up in touch early - driven approaching 3f out and dropped away - well beaten from there

Went straight to front but under pressure - stumbled 3rd and again 8th - challenged approaching 3 out - pushed clear when hampered in second at 2 out - two lengths adrift approaching last - fought back to score close home
Fought for control early - settled towards the back - pressed for effort and lost touch before 2 out - rallied approaching the last and closed to be second at the finish

Settled with strong grip early - close up second - clumsy first fence - unhurried second - shared front spot before three out - hit front then challenged again two out - two clear at the last but unable to find more and edged back in final strides to finish third
Settled towards the back - pressed for effort and lost ground before 2 out - still in contention approaching the last but couldn't quicken - finished fourth
settled in the pack - close up around 8th - shared the advantage before 3 out and soon pressed for effort - edged in front when came down at 2 out
Fought for control early - settled towards the back - pulled up before the 8th
settled midpack early - driven into contention passing the 2f marker - up to third with a furlong left - shaken up to hit the front close home and stay on for the win

Held up towards back of pack - urged forward over 2f out and made up ground - kept responding to reach front rank approaching final furlong - moved into second inside final 110yds - unable to reel in winner close home
tracked the leading group early - driven on with two furlongs left - responded under pressure inside the final furlong - moved into third late but lacked the speed to get closer
Sat close to front early - driven with two furlongs left - hit front inside final furlong - overtaken close home - couldn't find more finishing fourth
Held up towards the back - driven from over 2f out - finished strongly to close but held for 5th
Taken to the front early - disputing pace - hit the front approaching 2f out - driven out over a furlong from home - overtaken close home and unable to find more finishing sixth
towards the back of the pack - driven into contention approaching halfway - hampered a furlong out then shifted right to finish with running on well
Held up in midfield - nudged forward from 2f out and stayed on over the final furlong - always held in 8th
Settled prominently early - dropped away over 1f out - weakened final furlong to finish 9th
Settled around midfield - urged forward with 2f left - found some late response inside the final furlong but always held
Edged clear early - lost command over 2f out - stayed on at one gear to finish 11th beaten 5 lengths
settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - unable to find any headway - finished well held in 12th
Held handy in the pack early - driven for effort with 2f left - dropped away in the closing stages - finished 13th
Settled towards the back of the pack - asked for effort 2f out - couldn't find any extra and finished well held in 14th
Held up towards the back - urged forward around halfway - failed to threaten - finished well beaten in 15th
Held up in leading group - driven with 2f out - faded steadily to finish 16th
Settled midfield - urged forward with over 2f left - faded quickly thereafter - well held in 17th
Held up towards back - never able to challenge - well held at finish
Held up towards back of field - unable to land a blow - well held in 19th
Sat close to the leading group early - nudged for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - eventually well held
Held a spot just off the pace in the middle of the field early - driven for effort past the 2f marker - lost ground and dropped away final furlong to finish well beaten
Set the pace from the off - driven on with 2f left - drew clear in the final furlong to score comfortably
Slow to break - settled at back of field - made steady progress from 3f out under pressure - driven approaching final furlong - kept on well to take second late but no match for winner
Tracked the front group early - urged forward with two furlongs left - stayed on without gaining ground inside the final furlong - finished third
Handy early - driven 3f out then dropped back over 2f from home - stayed on same gear to finish 4th
Settled in the pack early - urged forward approaching 3f out to move into contention and up to third with 2f left - weakened close home to finish fifth beaten 5 lengths
Held a spot just off the pace early - moved into fourth before halfway - driven with over 2f out but drifted left - lost momentum inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Handy in the pack early - driven to keep tab before dropping away 2f out - eventually beaten 7 1/4 lengths in 7th
Held up towards back of pack - driven approaching 2f out - unable to improve position - finished eighth
Settled close to the front - lost touch approaching 3f out - beaten off before the finish - eventually came home 9th
Held up in the pack - pressed for effort 3f out - soon dropped away - finished well held in 10th
Held up towards the back - urged forward with over 2f left - failed to feature - finished 11th beaten 10 lengths
Fought for control early - sat close to pacesetter - pressed for effort 3f out - moved to front inside final furlong and stayed on strongly to win
Went clear early - pressed for effort 3f from home and lost command approaching final furlong - stayed on at one tempo to finish second beaten 3.25 lengths
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with 3f left and close to the front pair over 2f out - stayed on at one gear through the closing stages to finish third
Settled at back early - still close to leaders 3f out then pressed for effort - stayed on at one gallop late to finish 4th
Held up in rear throughout - never able to challenge - finished well held in 5th
Tracked the pace group early - made ground into third with 2f left - hit the front by the furlong marker - pulled clear in the final strides to win

Set the early gallop in front - shaken up over 2f out and edged off a true line - overtaken by a neck approaching the final furlong - couldn't match the winner's finishing speed and beaten 1¾ lengths in 2nd
Held a midfield position early - urged forward before two furlongs out and finished strongly from the furlong marker - moved into third close home finishing 4.5 lengths back
Held up at the back - urged forward 3f out - powered home late to close best of all
Prominent on the outside - driven to chase leaders 3f out - kept going without extra gears late - finished fifth beaten 5.5 lengths

Settled behind the front group early - moved into second spot 4f out - driven on with 3f left - stayed on for a spell before giving up ground inside the final furlong - weakened close home to finish sixth
Tardy start - dropped to the back and made gradual progress 3f out - picked up below 2f out and kept on - unable to land a blow in the closing stages
Handy in the pack early - pushed along with 2f left - unable to find extra - beaten in 8th
Held up towards the back - hampered two furlongs in - driven approaching final quarter mile and kept battling but always short of touch
Held up in midfield towards the wide side - urged forward 3f out - soon lost touch - finished well down the field
Held up towards the back - driven to make progress with over 2f left and closed on the pack - faded in the final furlong to finish 11th
Towards back of field early - driven approaching final 3f - well held throughout - finished 12th
Held up in the pack - moved into contention for fourth 3f out - faded from over 2f out to finish 13th
slow to break - settled towards the back - made progress 3f out - driven 2f out - faded inside the final furlong to finish 14th
Held up towards the back - urged forward with 3f left - unable to land a blow - eventually well held in 15th
Slow to begin - held a handy position in the pack - driven approaching 3f out then faded to finish last of 16
Slow to break - held up towards the back - driven over 2f out with nothing to show - well held in 17th
Slow to begin - settled midfield - driven 3f out then dropped away late
Held up in the pack early - lost touch rapidly with three furlongs left - well held at the finish

Went straight to front - lost command 6th before rallying to close on pacesetter by 3 out - driven to front again 2 out with a blunder there - edged clear approaching last - stayed on strongly to prevail

Settled in behind early - moved to front at the 6th - clear by a length 3 out - driven and put in front 2 out then faltered slightly - still in with a shout approaching the last then held on for second
Sat close to the pace early - slipped to the rear by the 6th - pressed for effort after the 10th and found little before 4 out - well held from there to the line
Held up towards the back - driven to challenge with three furlongs left - powered home wide in the closing stages to snatch it on the line

Held up towards the back - shifted left and made progress from over 2f out to join the fourth place group - kept responding into the final 110yds - fought for the front near the line - just caught in the closing strides for second
Tracked the pace - driven approaching 2f out and edged in front nearing the last furlong - stayed on - caught close home to finish third
Held up in midfield - found space to move through 3f out and briefly led 2f from home - kept going but couldn't find more late on finished fourth
Sat behind front group - driven 3f out and kept going - lacked the speed to get on terms
Set the pace early - driven approaching 2f out and edged in front approaching final furlong - dropped away 110yds from home to finish 6th
Tracked front group wide - urged forward with over 2f left and drifted left - unable to make headway - finished 7th beaten 4.25 lengths
Slow to begin - settled towards the back - driven up over 2f out and finished with running left in - squeezed for space inside the final furlong to finish eighth
Held a midfield position - pressed for effort with 2f left - faded through the closing stages to finish 9th
Settled in the pack - urged for effort with 3f left - found nothing in the closing stages - finished well held in 10th
Settled towards the back - out of contention before the 2f marker and faded to finish 11th
Held up towards the back - boxed in approaching 2f out - moved left with the field over 1f out - unable to quicken and beaten in 12th
Handy in the early stages - driven approaching final 3f - faded steadily thereafter - well held at the finish
Up with the front group - under pressure and fading from over 2f out - beaten 14 lengths in 14th
Mask taken off at the last moment - always last and well adrift - finished a distant 15th
Up with the pace - disputed the front 3 out - hit the front 2 out and driven forward - jumped the last untidily - challenged for top spot soon after - stayed on stoutly to win
Settled at the back - closed on the principals from 2 out - challenged for the lead approaching the last - stuck on at one speed to finish second
Held up in the pack - jumped awkwardly 3rd and needed a nudge by the 7th - urged on approaching 2 out - closed on the front group nearing the last - stayed on at one gear to finish third
Settled at the back - made a momentary move 2 out - came under pressure and never threatened on the run-in
Went clear early but scrambled over first - blundered 6th - challenged for advantage 3 out - lost place late and beaten well before last
